$comment: Where this project lives. The single place a human edits when it moves.
The repository has moved before and will move again: it began in a personal fork, lives in
OpenCyphal-Garage today, and is promoted to OpenCyphal at v1.0. Every other mention of the
owner in this tree -- documentation links, the README badge, mkdocs, the packaging homepage,
the manpage bug address -- is derived from this file by tools/repo_identity.py, and CI fails
on any that disagrees. Change these three strings, run `python3 tools/repo_identity.py --fix`,
Deliberately not covered: runtime/go/go.mod. Its module path is opencyphal.org/... precisely
so that it does not encode a GitHub owner and survives every such move untouched.
